short_summary: This document is a plan of approach for an internship at the HZ University of Applied Sciences, focusing on the KMP (Kennis Management Platform) where the author will be working as a data scientist. The main topics include background information about the organization and its mission, structure, and educational activities; the problem statement regarding the manual input required to upload unstructured project documents into the platform; and the objective of designing and implementing a Proof of Concept (PoC) for NLP techniques to automate this process.
